title: Shared definitions for the Recall adapter protocol

locator.description: Display-form locator, <source_id>:<local>. Only the owning adapter interprets the local part.

core_attached.description: Identity is assigned at Recall's boundary. An adapter may leave the field out or leave it empty; it may never name itself.

sensitivity.description: Ordered classification. A candidate may raise its source's floor, never lower it.

record_type.description: Open set: adapters may declare types the core has never seen.

search_outcome.description: An unreachable source reports unavailable, denied, failed, or timeout. It never reports success with no candidates.

diagnostics.description: Safe operational detail. A denied source must not leak record existence here.
